# Get Note Details

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Gets a detail about the note.

## Syntax

~~~~text
noteDetail(property: <#Enumeration (WFContentItemPropertyName)#>, note: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
noteDetail(property: Body, note: School Note)
~~~~
